packageRules.description: A pin on a fork commit, not a version. Renovate cannot know whether a newer SHA on someone else's branch is what we want, and bumping the SHA without the patch key it is only half of - see patchedDependencies in package.json - installs ghostty-web unpatched. The copy E2E then fails pointing at the copy function rather than at the cause. Bump it by hand, both halves together.

The packages whose updates are the reason this file exists: a minor in the plugin SDK changes the API this repo compiles against, and a TypeScript minor can change declaration output. Own PR, a label that survives triage, never automerged. No minimumReleaseAge override on purpose - the global one day already covers a published-broken version being pulled, and a longer age here would work against staying fresh.
